# Anne Shirley

## Appearance

Anne is tall, slender, and graceful, with an oval face, a milk-white skin, and large, expressive gray-green eyes that shine with starry brightness. She has a clear, delicate, pointed chin, a shapely nose, and a mobile face that vividly reflects her inner emotions. Her thick hair, famously red and freckled in her childhood, darkens as she matures into a rich, glossy auburn.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c2 P13](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0013), [v1 c2 P14](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0014), [v1 c10 P34](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0034), [v1 c25 P0](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0000), [v1 c31 P15](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0015), [v2 c1 P0](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0000), [v3 c12 P17](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0017), [v3 c25 P43](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0043), [v3 c33 P13](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0013), [v3 c36 P12](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0012), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001)_

## Personality

Anne is an intensely imaginative, passionate, and romantic individual who possesses a deep love for nature and beauty. She is warm-hearted, fiercely loyal to her friends, and possesses an impulsive, vivid nature that makes her feel both joy and sorrow with extreme intensity. Though quick-tempered and prone to dramatic daydreams in her youth, she matures into a wise, empathetic, and sweet-tempered woman while retaining her youthful zest for life and capacity for joy. She has a natural gift for winning the affection of others, particularly children and kindred spirits, and possesses a subtle, irrepressible sense of humor.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c2 P24](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0024), [v1 c9 P16](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0016), [v1 c15 P93](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0093), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c31 P20](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0020), [v2 c1 P2](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0002), [v2 c1 P23](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0023), [v2 c7 P17](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0017), [v3 c1 P28](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0028), [v3 c4 P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069), [v3 c14 P29](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0029), [v5 c1 P1](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0001)_

## History

Anne Shirley arrived at Green Gables in Avonlea by mistake, as Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert had intended to adopt a boy to help on their farm; however, they quickly decided to keep her. She formed an enduring bosom-friendship with her neighbor Diana Barry and developed a fierce school rivalry with Gilbert Blythe after he called her 'Carrots.' Over her girlhood years in Avonlea, Anne got into various humorous and dramatic scrapes, including accidentally intoxicating Diana with currant wine and dying her hair green, but earned the affection of the community through her sweetness, bright mind, and vivid imagination. After attending Queen's Academy and winning the Avery Scholarship, Anne chose to remain at Green Gables to teach in Avonlea and care for Marilla following Matthew's sudden death. During her time as a schoolteacher, she organized the Avonlea Village Improvement Society and befriended many neighbors, including the eccentric Mr. Harrison, Paul Irving, and Miss Lavendar Lewis. She later attended Redmond College in Kingsport alongside her friends, earning her B.A. degree and rejecting a marriage proposal from the wealthy Roy Gardner when she realized she did not truly love him. Reconciling with Gilbert Blythe after he recovered from a dangerous bout of typhoid fever, Anne realized her love for him and accepted his proposal. Following three years of teaching in Summerside, Anne married Gilbert in the orchard at Green Gables. The newlyweds settled at Four Winds Harbor in a cozy cottage dubbed the 'house of dreams,' where Anne befriended her tragic neighbor Leslie Moore and the lighthouse keeper Captain Jim. After tragically losing her firstborn infant daughter, Joyce, Anne gave birth to a healthy son, James Matthew ('Jem'). When Gilbert's medical practice expanded, the family relocated to the larger estate of Ingleside in Glen St. Mary, where Anne raised her growing family—Jem, Walter, twins Nan and Di, Shirley, and Rilla—and welcomed her old friend Mrs.

## Background by volume

- Born in Bolingbroke, Nova Scotia, to schoolteachers Walter and Bertha Shirley, who both died of fever when she was three months old  <sub>[v1 c5 P11](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0011), [v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013)</sub>
- Raised in poverty by Mrs. Thomas and later Mrs. Hammond, helping to care for numerous children and twins  <sub>[v1 c5 P13](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0013), [v1 c5 P14](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0014)</sub>
- Lived in the Hopeton Orphanage for four months before being brought to Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P19](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0019), [v1 c5 P15](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0015)</sub>
- Adopted by sibling farmers Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert of Green Gables in Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005)</sub>
- Attended Queen's Academy, earning a First Class Teacher's License and winning the Avery Scholarship  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 c36 P7](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0007)</sub>
- Gave up her college scholarship to stay at Green Gables and teach in Avonlea after Matthew Cuthbert's death  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c38 P18](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0018), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- Attended Redmond College in Kingsport, graduating with a Bachelor of Arts degree and winning the Thorburn Scholarship  <sub>[v3 c31 P3](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0003), [v3 c36 P7](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0007), [v3 c36 P12](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0012)</sub>
- Served as Principal of Summerside High School for three years prior to her marriage  <sub>[v4 c1 P4](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0004), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005)</sub>
